title: metadata: history retention keeps the latest N per (type, name), so one package's saves evict another package's versions
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32351（PR #32569）专题红线复读 6818909551 点名的余项。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150), nested under #32351 (the epic is at the sub-issue cap). Blocked-by #32569.

## What

`packages/metadata/src/utils/history-cleanup.ts` enforces `maxVersions` per `(type, name)` (the retention walk near :134 and the count walk near :281 on `main`). After PR #32569, two packages (and the environment) each keep their own history for one name of a by-package type, in the same `(type, name, version)` sequence. Retention by `(type, name)` therefore counts both packages' versions together, so one package's saves evict the other package's versions: package B loses rollback targets because package A was saved often.

## Acceptance

- For a by-package type, retention keeps the latest N versions per `(type, name, package_id)`, with the environment marker as its own bucket and unattributed legacy rows (NULL) as their own bucket.
- Non-slotted types and a one-holder name keep exactly today's retention (CONTROL).
- Pins per type in the live `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`: A saved N+k times, B saved twice: B keeps both versions.
- `Clause-②:` measured (an internal retention change; expected `no`).

## 业务理由

谁受益：在多包环境里按包回滚定制的管理员。场景：A 包的同名元数据频繁保存。不做：B 包的历史版本被 A 包的保存挤掉，B 想回滚时已无版本可选。

## 读者

`domain:server` 席位（专题 #31527 派），#32569 合并后；起点 `history-cleanup.ts` 的两处 `uniqueKeys` 分组。

## 查重
